have h_main : (countDigits (s) h_precond) - List.length (List.filter isDigit (s.toList)) = 0 := by
    have h₁ : countDigits (s) h_precond = List.length (List.filter isDigit (s.toList)) := rfl
    rw [h₁]
    <;> simp
    <;> omega

  have h_main₂ : List.length (List.filter isDigit (s.toList)) - countDigits (s) h_precond = 0 := by
    have h₁ : countDigits (s) h_precond = List.length (List.filter isDigit (s.toList)) := rfl
    have h₂ : List.length (List.filter isDigit (s.toList)) - countDigits (s) h_precond = 0 := by
      omega
    exact h₂

  exact ⟨h_main, h_main₂⟩
